title: : YOU AND YOUR CREA TION MANDA TE
verse: “. be conformed to the image of his Son.” (KJV)
body: : YOU AND YOUR CREA TION MANDA TE “. be conformed to the image of his Son.” (KJV) Rom 8:29. He’s pleased when you please Him - He wants you to mirror His likeness by your conduct, character and comportment. You must be a representation of God’s image. Whosoever you are, you must epitomise His life. In a commanding tone, the Bible declares “Put on your new nature, and be renewed as you learn to know your Creator and become like him” (NLT) Col 3:10. Becoming like Him is God’s ultimate goal. And we must fulfil it! 1. O to be like Thee! blessed Redeemer; This is my constant longing and prayer; Gladly I’ll forfeit all of earth’s treasures, Jesus, Thy perfect likeness to wear. 2. O to be like Thee! full of compassion, Loving, forgiving, tender and kind, Helping the helpless, cheering the fainting, Seeking the wand’ring sinners to find 3. O to be like Thee! While I am pleading, Pour out Thy Spirit, fill with Thy love. Make me a temple meet for Thy dwelling, Fit for a life which Thou wouldst approve.
prayer: 1. Worship Him in the beauty of His holiness 2. Ask for the cleansing blood of Jesusto make you whiter than snow 3. Dedicate your life afresh 4. Come against every satanic plan.

title: : IN HIS IMAGE
verse: “God blessed them. God said to them, "Be fruitful,
body: : IN HIS IMAGE “God blessed them. God said to them, "Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion.” (WEB) Gen 1:28 “Work hard so God can say to you, "Well done." Be a good workman, one who does not need to be ashamed when God examines your work. Know what his Word says and means” (TLB) 2 Tim 2:15. You’re created to r e-create your world. And this you must do to fulfil your place in destiny. “God blessed them: "Prosper! Reproduce! Fill Earth! Take charge! Be responsible for fish in the sea and birds in the air, for every living thing that moves on the face of Earth.” (TBCL) Gen 1:28. God wants you to fill the earth with the wonders of His grace. Work in the consciousness of a creator in all areas of life. You are not to be limited! You’re a solution provider! You have only one life! And that will soon be gone. Make it count. Make your world a better one - recreate it - don’t leave it the way you met it! Ralph Waldo Emerson said, “The purpose of life is not to be happy. It is to be useful, to be honorable, to be compassionate, to have it make some difference that you have lived and lived well.”
confession: I will brighten my corner every day. And make my world, a better one.

title: : CREA TED TO RECREA TE YOUR WORLD
verse: being made conformable unto his death” (KJV)
body: : CREA TED TO RECREA TE YOUR WORLD “That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death” (KJV) Phili 3:10 No one can do without God in this life-long journey. “Moses said, "I pray thee, show me thy glory."” (RSV) Exo 33:18. David declared, “As the hart panteth after the water-brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God. My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God.” (DT) Ps 42:1-2. No one sees Him without searching for Him. You can only see Him when you search with all your heart. Mary wanted Him at all cost - waiting and weeping - to see her Man and Master - JESUS! John 20:11-13. Until you give up the inferior, you can’t gain the superior. It’s as simple and hard as that! The greatest goal of every sincere Christian should be in hot pursuit of God.
prayer: 1. Worship Him for all He has done for you 2. Abandon yourself in His presence - ask Him for a closer walk 3. Come against every spirit of inconsistency 4. Ask that He bears you up in the strength of the Spirit 5. Bind all the activities of the devil over your life and family and render his plans null and void 6. Commit your day into His hands.

title: : IN PURSUIT OF GOD
body: : IN PURSUIT OF GOD “. and said to them, Be fruitful, multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it [using all its vast resources in the service of God and man]; and have dominion over.” (AMP) Gen 1:28 Subdue - conquer and triumph over - it! That’s God speaking in precision! No ambiguity! We’re redeemed to redeem destinies. Our service is of two categories: service to God and service to man. The word, subdue is from Hebrew kabash meaning, to tread down and keep under. It’s related to Arabic kabasa to seize with hand. In taking your place, don’t forget, there are forces to be subdued and brought under bondage. “See, I have appointed you this day over the nations and over the kingdoms, To pluck up and to break down, To destroy and to overthrow, To build and to plant” (NASB) Jer 1:10. That’s your responsibility - to pluck up and break down - so as to establish God’s reign on earth. You’re sent to unbuild and build, to unplant and plant. Take over among nations and in governments. Be a living proof!
prayer: 1. Thank God for today’s study 2. Ask the Holy Spirit to quicken you in your innermost being and set fire in your bones 3. Pray for the power of focus in all you do 4. Tell Him about your needs.

title: : SENT TO SUBDUE
verse: to His riches in glory.” (HCSB) Phili 4:19
body: : SENT TO SUBDUE “And my God will supply all your needs according to His riches in glory.” (HCSB) Phili 4:19 Tony Robbins said, “It’s not the events of our lives that shape us, but our beliefs as to what those events mean.” God’s ability to bless you is not tied to your purse or bank account. He fed the Children of Israel with manna for forty years. He sent raven to feed Elijah in famine. He fed 5, 000 people miraculously. “And God is able to make all grace (every favor and earthly blessing) come to you in abundance, so that you may always and under all circumstances and whatever the need be self-sufficient [possessing enough to require no aid or support and furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation].” (Amp) 2 Cor 9:8. Don’t make what others have to be the basis of measuring yourself. No need competing or comparing. Believe in His ability to supply A-L-L your needs. “And my God will liberally supply ( fill to the full) your every need according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus” (AMP) Phili 4:19, Don’t confess penury even when you don’t have money - confess the Word, Ps 23:1.
prayer: 1. Renounce every scarcity mentality 2. Release yourself from negative thinking and lack.

title: : GET RID OF SCARCITY MIND-SET
body: : GET RID OF SCARCITY MIND-SET “Train up a child.” (KJV) Pro 22:6 Every parent, would-be parent, guidance and instructor must take responsibility for the sound upbringing of the children. “Point your kids in the right direction - when they're old they won't be lost” (TBCL) Pro 22:6. Teach them everything. Don’t hide the truth from them. Here are a number of things to teach: 1. Teach them to be good - point them to Christ as the Master and Mentor 2. Teach them to be respectful and never to be rude in all their ways 3. Teach them to be assertive in confronting unhealthy and unfair treatment. 4. Teach them about the power of focus in all they do 5. Teach them about cleanliness and healthy lifestyles. “Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right” (CEV) Pro 22:6. Above all, allow God to lead you in leading them, 1 Tim 4:12.
prayer: 1. Bless God for those children under your care 2. Pray for God’s wisdom to train them in God’s way 3. Pray for the grace to be temperate in moments of their misconducts 4. Cancel every plan of the devil against them and cover them with the blood of Jesus.

title: : EQUIP THEM FOR THE REAL WORLD!
body: : EQUIP THEM FOR THE REAL WORLD!

title: : BE NOT DECEIVED
verse: yourself! You will harvest what you plant” (CEV)
body: : BE NOT DECEIVED “You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant” (CEV) Gal 6:7 Apostle Paul uses the maxim of agriculture to teach an enduring lesson. The fruit we reap is always consistent with the seed we have sown. The biggest and most costly lie is not the one told us by someone else but rather, the one we tell ourselves. Verses 8-9 of our text read, “For he who sows to his own flesh (lower nature, sensuality) will from the flesh reap decay and ruin and destruction, but he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life. And let us not lose heart and grow weary and faint in acting nobly and doing right, for in due time and at the appointed season we shall reap, if we do not loosen and relax our courage and faint” (AMP). We cannot live and dine with the devil and imagine to reap heaven. Can we sow to the flesh now and reap the spiritual reward hereafter? No one makes a fool of God. What a person plants, that will he harvest. “Who will render to every man according to his deeds.” (KJV) Rom 2:5-8.
prayer: Pray as led about today's study. And pray with Special Breakthrough Prayers. “What is man that You are mindful of him, and the son of [earthborn] man that You care for him? Yet You have made him but a little lower than God [or heavenly beings], and You have crowned him with glory and honor. You made him to have dominion over the works of Your hands; You have put all things under his feet” (AMP) Ps 8:4-6. God created man from the dust of the ground and crowned him with glory and honour. God installed man as His regent on earth both to rule and be inl dominion. When sin came in, humanity limped along in faded glory. But a moment came when Christ’s sacrificial death and victorious resurrection led humanity back to God. In Jesus, the work of our glorification begins. As we walk with Him, we “are being transformed into the same image from one degree of glory to another” [2 Cor 3:18]. Yet still, there is a greater realm of glory - which the mouth can’t tell it all now - that is awaiting us in our resurrection bodies [1 Cor 15:42–43] and the coming new heaven and new earth [2 Pet 3:13; Rev 21:1, 5-7, 24-26].

title: : CROWNED WITH GLOR Y AND HONOUR
body: : CROWNED WITH GLOR Y AND HONOUR “Leave no [such] room or foothold for the devil [give no opportunity to him]” (AMP) Eph 4:27 “Be well balanced (temperate, sober of mind), be vigilant and cautious at all times; for that enemy of yours, the devil, roams around like a lion roaring [in fierce hunger], seeking someone to seize upon and devour” (Amp) 1 Pet 5:8. Your adversary, the devil, is a real entity, not just a mythical being. He is the wicked one [Matt 13:19, 38], the accuser of the brethren [Rev 12:10], the ruler of this world [John 12:31], the god of this age [2 Cor 4:4] and the prince of the power of the air [Eph 2:2]. “So give yourselves to God. Stand against the devil, and he will run away from you” (ERV) Jam 4:7. It doesn’t matter what you are going through. There is power in the blood of Jesus to set free. Are you afflicted, sick, oppressed or tormented? Are there cases that defy medication? Are you prone to accident? Are you experiencing delay and all kinds of negative occurrences? Weep no more! The Lion of the tribe of Judah has conquered.
prayer: 1. Start with a warfare song 2. Declare your total submission to God 3. Plead the blood of Jesus 4. Release the Holy Ghost fire upon the root of negative occurrences 5. Pray with Isa 49:24-26.

title: : DISALLOWING DEMONIC DOMINION
body: : DISALLOWING DEMONIC DOMINION “. this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind.” (KJV) Phili 3:13 Do you find yourself brooding over worst situations about your relationship, job, health or family almost everyday? Did he or she walk out of that relationship? Were you sacked from that job? Could it be that you’ve been battling with certain health condition that seems lingering? Are there matters yet unresolved at home or work? Did you lose that opportunity to travel out of the Country? Give Him all your worries - He cares and He will carry you through. Heed this godly counsel: decide to be joyful no matter what. Joy comes from within; no one is responsible for making you unjoyful - take responsibility for your joy. Forgive yourself, consciously put behind you that ugly situation and forge ahead confidently.
prayer: 1. Bring every matter causing you emotional pain to the throne of mercy - tell Him to have His way 2. Pray for inner strength to forge ahead 3. Pray for emotionally troubled people 4. Pray for other issues of your life. [Sing this: ‘Living by faith in Jesus above, trusting, confiding in His great love; From all harm safe in His sheltering arm, I’m living by faith and feel no alarm’]

title: 1: ST OP BROODING OVER THE P AST!
body: 1: ST OP BROODING OVER THE P AST! “Abel brought the best parts from some of the firstborn of his flock. The Lord accepted Abel and his gift” (NCV) Gen 4:4 God is always interested in the offerer before the offering. Acceptability is all about the giver before the gift and not vice versa. God had respect to Abel and his offering being faithbased. Faith helps to secure divine honour. Faithoffering honours God and God in turn honours the offerer. “. by it he being dead yet speaketh.” Here is an honourable mention of Abel. Though dead, but his faith offering could not be forgotten. Are there not saints of old whose faith-legacy, faith-adventure and faith-offering are still speaking till today? What faith-contribution have you thought of today? The beauty of each day is in your daily faith contributions.
confession: I am consciously committing myself to daily faith-contribution. If I can’t help out with a million, I’ll help with a thousand; If I can’t help with a thousand, I’ll help with a mite; if I can’t help with a mite, I’ll show kindness. By all means, I’ll make my life count and attract His attention. [Think of an individual in need. Send a financial or material help and attract the supernatural].

title: : ATTRACTING THE SUPERNA TURAL
body: : ATTRACTING THE SUPERNA TURAL “He who refuses and ignores instruction and correction despises himself, but he who heeds reproof gets understanding” (AMP) Pro 15:32 We all make mistakes - some are accidental while others are not. No matter the magnitude of any mistake and no matter how costly, God can amend your life and make it beautiful again. It’s not just about falling, it’s about not remaining falling. If you can admit your mistake, confess it, and promise God not to repeat it, He will forgive you and relate with you as if you never went wrong. Something is amazing about the life of David, [Acts 13:22], he was such a man who will not cover up. When prophet Nathan confronted him about his affair with Bathsheba and his attempt to cover the pregnancy by having her husband dead, David quickly acknowledged, “. I have sinned against the LORD.” (KJV) 2 Sam 12:13. That’s the right spirit! Don’t pretend! Admit it! Confess it! And don’t repeat it again!
prayer: 1. Thank God for the insight 2. If there is any sinful practice that satan is using against you, confess and settle it with God 3. Pray to God to keep sustaining and watching over your life.

title: : ACKNOWLEDGE YOUR MIST AKES
body: : ACKNOWLEDGE YOUR MIST AKES “Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities” (KJV) Jude 1:8 “And especially those who walk according to the flesh in the lust of uncleanness and despise authority. They are presumptuous, self-willed. They are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries” (NKJV) 2 Pet 2:10. See a consistent command of God not to speak evil of dignities. “Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work, To speak evil of no man.” (KJV) Titus 3:1-2. The focus above is not to be slanderers and critics. The Bible does not prohibit Christians from raising their voices against evil, Eph 2:11. As individuals or bodies, our banner must be raised to promote godliness in our land. Let’s join our hands and voices together and fight the devil, 2 Cor 10:3-5.
prayer: 1. Go ahead and thank God for your beloved Country and her leaders at different levels of government 2. Decree peace of your Country - pray for tranquility in the North, South, East and West 3. Command God’s judgment on those seeking the downfall of the Country 4. Pray for the spread of the gospel light in your Country.

title: : DON’T SPEAK EVIL OF DIGNITIES
verse: iniquity have dominion over me” (WEB) Ps 119:133
body: : DON’T SPEAK EVIL OF DIGNITIES “Establish my footsteps in your word. Don't let any iniquity have dominion over me” (WEB) Ps 119:133 If there is any serious prayer for any serious Christian, it’s that your feet might be established in the Word and that the power of iniquity might be rendered impotent over your life. Learn Ps 119:133 by heart and pray it daily. The Power over sin is not in your self; it’s in the Scripture, “But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name” (KJV) John 1:12. When you were born again, He gave you the power and ability to say NO to sin and all forms of ungodliness. “. So now we serve not under [obedience to] the old code of written regulations, but [under obedience to the promptings] of the Spirit in newness [of life]” (AMP) Rom 7:6. At salvation, a new power is in operation - the power of JESUS! “A new power is in operation. The Spirit of life in Christ, like a strong wind, has magnificently cleared the air, freeing you from a fated lifetime of brutal tyranny at the hands of sin and death” (TBCL) Rom 8:2. Read Gal 5:18 and Rom 6:14.
prayer: 1. Thank Him for His Words 2. Spend time to pray with Ps 119:133 - decree your victory.

title: : DOMINION OVER SIN
body: : DOMINION OVER SIN “God wants you to be holy and to stay away from sexual sins” (NCV) 1 Thes 4:3 Sex and its pleasure is God’s idea. He created it for our satisfaction. But, He wants it expressed in marriage. We aren’t dogs who feel the urge and have to act just that way - without control! “It is God's will that you should be sanctified: that you should avoid sexual immorality; that each of you should learn to control his own body in a way that is holy and honorable, not in passionate lust like the heathen, who do not know God” (NIV) 1 Thes 4:3-5. Our sanctification is His satisfaction! Stay away from sexual immorality, 1 Tim 5:2. Do you engage in immoral fantasies? Are you in bondage to lust? Are you involved in masturbation? Are you addicted to pornography and nude pictures? Are you engaged in sexual activity outside of marriage? If your answer is yes in any of these, seek God’s help and be free. Each time sexual thoughts come to you, use the Word. Besides, get rid of stumbling blocks - keep away from friends, groups or sites - that are polluting.
prayer: 1. In an aggressive prayer, come against the spirit of immorality 2. Pray for power to live a godly life 3. Pray for the purity of the body of Christ.

title: : SEXUAL DESIRE AND SELF CONTROL
verse: knew, will he inflict on you.” (ESV) Deut 7:15
body: : SEXUAL DESIRE AND SELF CONTROL “. the Lord will take away from you all sickness, and none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you knew, will he inflict on you.” (ESV) Deut 7:15 Sickness can be very devastating and demoralising. It paralyses visions, shatters dreams, hinders achievement and turns lives to chaos. “He said, "If you will listen carefully to the voice of the Lord your God and do what is right in his sight, obeying his commands and keeping all his decrees, then I will not make you suffer any of the diseases I sent on the Egyptians; for I am the Lord who heals you." (NLT) Exo 15:26. When you serve Him, He services your life so as to serve Him more. “So you shall serve the LORD your God, and He will bless your bread and your water. And I will take sickness away from the midst of you” (NKJV) Exo 23:25. You’ve dominion over sickness. Satan has no right to inflict sickness on your body. Note it and walk in this consciousness, 1 Pet 2:24.
prayer: [Take any healing song of your choice] 1. Thank God for what Jesus has accomplished for you 2. Enforce your dominion over sickness 3. Intercede for the sick. [Reach out to people within your circle of influence with free copies of My Heart-to-Heart Talk this Christmas season.]

title: : DOMINION OVER SICKNESS
body: : DOMINION OVER SICKNESS “It is God who has delivered us out of the dominion of darkness.” (WNT) Col1:13 Satan is a real person - with intelligence - his goal is to steal, kill, and destroy [John 10:10]. You have DO-M-I-N-I-O-N over him, his activities and cohorts. When Jesus gave his life on the cross, He conquered satan and gave us the victory. “Having disarmed principalities and powers, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them in it” (NKJV) Col 2:15. Put Satan in his place - he’s defeated - enforce just that! You need not fear Satan. Exercise the authority which God has given you over the Devil. Every person whose name has been written in the Lamb’s Book of Life has been given authority, Luke 10:19. The Devil detests an atmosphere of true worship. Lifting up Jesus in worship sends the devil running! By submitting to God [keeping away from disobedience, unforgiveness and the like], and exercising your authority in the name of Jesus, you’re more powerful than the enemy, 1 John 4:4.
prayer: [Sing a warfare song] 1. Thank God for His power at work in you 2. Declare your right and dominion over satan, his activities and cohorts 3. Nullify every work of darkness over your life.

title: : DOMINION OVER SA TANIC ACTIVITIES
body: : DOMINION OVER SA TANIC ACTIVITIES “Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place? He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity.” (NKJV) Ps 24:3-5 If there is any key so essential to dominion, it’s no other key than a life of righteousness and uprightness; a life void of fraud, bribery and oppression; a life free of bloodshed and evil in all its magnitude. That’s the kind of life that would see the King of Kings in action. Such life would be defended by God, Isa 33:15-17. “He who walks righteously and speaks uprightly, who despises gain from fraud and from oppression, who shakes his hand free from the taking of bribes, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed and shuts his eyes to avoid looking upon evil. [Such a man] will dwell on the heights; his place of defense will be the fortresses of rocks; his bread will be given him; water for him will be sure.” (AMP). God’s expectation is not beyond you. “The answer's simple: Live right, speak the truth, despise exploitation, refuse bribes.” Isa 33: 15-17.
prayer: 1. Decree your dominion over sinful habits 2. Commit yourself to God’s able hand. [Hymn: Are You Washed In The Blood?]

title: : KEY TO PERPETUAL DOMINION
body: : KEY TO PERPETUAL DOMINION “But we preach Christ crucified.” (RSV) 1Cor 1:23 Take advantage - and maximize every opportunity - to spread the Word. “. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship” (KJV) Luke 5:3. Jesus took advantage of every opportunity to dominate His world with the Word. He preached the message of the kingdom, “And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people” (KJV) Matt 9:35. Jesus commanded, “And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand” (KJV) Matt 10:7. As you go to work, office, market, anywhere you go, spread the Word in your world. Paul speaking in agreement said, “And He commanded us to preach to the people, and to testify that it is He who was ordained by God to be Judge of the living and the dead” (NKJV) Acts 10:42.
prayer: 1. Tell Him you’re sorry for not taking the spread of the Word seriously 2. Pray for a heart set on fire for this eternal cause 3. Intercede for sinners and backsliders [Hymn: Must I Go, And EmptyHanded?]. Go, share the gospel today.

title: : DOMINA TING YOUR WORLD WITH HIS WORD
body: : DOMINA TING YOUR WORLD WITH HIS WORD “She considereth a field, and buyeth it; With the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard. She girdeth her loins with strength, And maketh strong her arms” (ASV) Pro 31:16-17 The importance of alternative sources of income can not be overemphasized. It gives you financial freedom. And financial freedom begins with a careful consideration: what can I do with my hands? What are my areas of interest and abilities? Do I need to learn and acquire skills and expertise? Be sincere and objective. Then, start with what you have where you are. When it comes to starting a new business, you can seek financial help from friends or family members. But where this is not forthcoming, consider personal savings. It’s just the matter of time. Or sell those things you don’t use often for what you need - money! With a resolute determination, you can start that business.
prayer: 1. In your own words, appreciate God for moments of challenges [Rom 8:28] 2. Tell God you are sorry for moments of self-pity, murmuring and complaint 3. Pray fervently that God should lead you in every step of the way as you start with what you have 4. War against vicious circle of poverty.

title: : YOU NEED MUL TIPLE STREAMS OF INCOME
body: : YOU NEED MUL TIPLE STREAMS OF INCOME “Let the elders who take the lead [among the saints] well be esteemed worthy of double honour, specially those labouring in word and teaching” (DT) 1 Tim 5:17 The depth of honour you give to those in authority is a function of the depth of God’s knowledge you possess. One level of authority that God has granted to men is governmental [Rom 13:1-6]. When we resist the authority, we are actually resisting God, Col 3:22-24. Another level of authority established by God is within the home. Eph 5:22-24 commands wives to submit to their husbands as they would submit to God. Children are commanded to submit to their parents [Eph 6:1 and Col 3:20]. God also established specific authority within the church. “And now, friends, we ask you to honor those leaders who work so hard for you, who have been given the responsibility of urging and guiding you along in your obedience.” (TBCL) 1 Thes 5:12-13 and1 Pet 5:5-6.
prayer: 1. Thank God for this revelation 2. Ask God to help you in operating within your rank 3. Pray for those in authorities in government, home and Church 4. Destroy all the activities of the enemy against them 5. Commit your day to God.

title: : ESTEEM THOSE IN AUTHORITY
body: : ESTEEM THOSE IN AUTHORITY PRA YER“One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after.” (KJV) Ps 27:4 David was a man of one thing. He wanted nothing but God. His dream, drive and determination was about the Divinity, Ps 26:8. In spite of David's painful experiences, he could have desired safety and a thousand of other good things, but no, he set his heart on God, and left the rest just for Him to take care of (Phil 3:13). Desires alone are not enough. Our desires must be backed up with resolute, firm and steadfast action. Desires are like seeds which must be sown in the good soil of action, or else they will yield no fruits. Where there is no commensurate practical action, our desires would end up like thick clouds without rain. “You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart” (HCSB) Jer 29:13. God judges us by the desire of our hearts. Our desires should be specific, constant, fervent, focussed, growth-oriented and within time frame.
prayer: 1. Ask for more of God 2. Pray for divine help that will keep you going in hot pursuit of His likeness [Sing the Song: Lord, prepare me to be a sanctuary, pure and holy, tried and true, With thanksgiving, I'll be a living, Sanctuary for You.]

title: : ONE THING
body: : ONE THING “. whom have I oppressed. And they said, Thou hast not. oppressed us.” (KJV) 1 Sam 12;3-4 The reign of Ahab and Jezebel over Israel was one of the most depressing period in the history of God’s people. One of the traits in Jezebel was her domineering spirit. When she became a queen, she ordered the extermination of all the prophets of God and replaced their altars with those of Baal [1 King 18:4, 13]. What about her domineering spirit over her husband in forcefully taking over the inheritance of Naboth? [1 King 21:3-16]. Jezebel had an evil controlling spirit. Such spirit always want to dominate and manipulate people and situations. “He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress” (KJV) Hos 12:7. Jezebel also did her evil under a religious covering [1 King 21:9]. It is dangerous, when you use Scripture and the name of God to control and manipulate others. Here is God’s promise for your freedom, Isa 10:27.
prayer: 1. Father, I disconnect myself from a domineering, controlling and manipulating spirit 2. Father, help me to be of godly influence 3. Almighty God, separate me from the spirit of insolent and wrong decision making.

title: : BREAKING FREE FROM DOMINEERING SPIRIT
body: : BREAKING FREE FROM DOMINEERING SPIRIT “And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places.” (KJV) Eph 2:6 TLB says, “And lifted us up from the grave into glory along with Christ, where we sit with him in the heavenly realms-all because of what Christ Jesus did.” You’re raised up in Him and with Him to rule - reign, govern and power over. “And He raised us up together with Him and made us sit down together [giving us joint seating with Him] in the heavenly sphere [by virtue of our being] in Christ Jesus (the Messiah, the Anointed One)” (Amp). You are seated not in high places but in heavenly places “Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come” (KJV) Eph 1:21. Your position is in heaven, GWT says, “God has brought us back to life together with Christ Jesus and has given us a position in heaven with him.” In Him you have your being. You’re a joint-heir, Rom 8:17 and Heb 6:17.
prayer: 1. Thank Him for your position of honour in Christ 2. Turn your Bible to Eph 1:21 and decree you dominion over all principalities 3. Render null and void every satanic plan against your life and family.

title: : YOU DWELL IN HEA VENL Y PLACES
body: : YOU DWELL IN HEA VENL Y PLACES “And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly.” (KJV) Rom 16:20 That God is interested in your peace is no news. He desires your peace - peace in your soul, peace in your innermost being, peace in your body, peace in your home and peace in your business. When the Bible says, the God of peace shall bruise satan under your feet, God says what He means and means what He says. “And the evil-doers will be crushed under you, they will be dust under your feet, in the day when I do my work, says the Lord of armies” (BBE) Mal 4:3. You have mastery - authority and rule - over monsters [leviathan, beasts and over all powers: power of witchcraft, mummy water power, demonic power, evil power] and nothing shall by any means hurt you. “Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood. that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil; And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage” (KJV) Heb 2:14-15.
confession: [Sing a warfare song] I have authority over leviathan, beasts and over all powers and nothing shall by any means hurt me.

title: : YOUR MASTER Y OVER MONSTERS
verse: that my soul knoweth right well” (KJV) Ps 139:14
body: : YOUR MASTER Y OVER MONSTERS “I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well” (KJV) Ps 139:14 The human body is the most unique structure on earth. Our bodies are such an awesome exhibition of God's unfathomable and inconceivable skill and expertise. “When I look up into the night skies and see the work of your fingers-the moon and the stars you have made - I cannot understand how you can bother with mere puny man, to pay any attention to him!” (TLB) Ps 8:3-4. The human brain is an amazing organ - fearfully and wonderfully made - it has the ability to learn, reason and control numerous functions, Ps 139:15. God made you in His way! You’re intricately wrought by the hand of the living God! Your fearfulness came directly from Him. No need for haughtiness! Glorify God in your body - your body is not made for prostitution, homosexuality, immorality and iniquity of any kind - it is packaged for God and His purpose, Ps 100:3.
prayer: 1. Declare your body as the temple of God 2. Reject every spirit that is not of God 3. Cancel every spirit of inferiority complex 4. Stand in the gap for friends and families.

title: : YOU’RE SO SPECIAL!
body: : YOU’RE SO SPECIAL! “You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hid” (RSV) Matt 5:14 Everyone has a circle of influence. We all - in one way or the other - influence someone. God wants us to be shining lights - radiating His grace and heralding His glory. He didn’t give us our influence for nothing, He gave us that influence so we can be and bear the light to the world. TBCL puts our text thus, “Here's another way to put it: You're here to be light, bringing out the God-colors in the world. God is not a secret to be kept. We're going public with this, as public as a city on a hill.” So, let your light so shine! “Let your light so shine before men that they may see your moral excellence and your praiseworthy, noble, and good deeds and recognize and honor and praise and glorify your Father Who is in heaven” (Amp) Matt 5:16. Influence is a spiritual muscle. The more you use it, the more it grows. Use your position, power, fame and wealth for kingdom growth.
prayer: Father, I ask for Your help to undertake the noble assignment of radiating Your grace and heralding Your glory in Jesus’ name, Amen. [Arrange a free distribution of My Heart-to-Heart Talk for individuals, groups and Churches.]

title: : INFLUENCING YOUR WORLD OF INFLUENCE
verse: “And be renewed in the spirit of your mind” (NKJV)
body: : INFLUENCING YOUR WORLD OF INFLUENCE “And be renewed in the spirit of your mind” (NKJV) Eph 4:23 We’ve been commanded, “And be constantly renewed in the spirit of your mind [having a fresh mental and spiritual attitude]” (Amp) Eph 4:23. You know why? The life goes where the mind leads - that makes the mind a doorway into who we really are. For satan to fight a man’s destiny, he brings the battle to the mind. You can always win such battle! You can defeat the devil. You can live victoriously over fear, lust and desires of the flesh. You can truly live by the Spirit. Hear this, “. that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind, Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart. But ye have not so learned Christ; If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus.” (KJV) Eph 4:17-22, 24. Be sure you feed the mind with correct meals, Phil 4:6-8 and allow God’s Word to guide you daily, Col 3:16. CONFESSIONS: He reigns, and so do I. His grace is at work in me. By the reason of His resurrection power, I’ve dominion over fear and evil.

title: : IT BEGINS WITHIN
body: : IT BEGINS WITHIN “. the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first” (KJV) 1 Thes 4:16 “Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air.” (KJV) 1 Thes 4:17-18. The Rapture [the catching up of the saints] is a glorious event that God promises His Church. The term Rapture comes from a Latin word, rapio, meaning to take out or to snatch away. At the blowing of a trumpet and the shout of an archangel, Jesus will appear in the sky and take up His Church, dead and living, to Heaven. “Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed, In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, (KJV) 1 Cor 15: 51-52. The rapture shall be in a split second - no one knows the hour. So, that day must not meet you unprepared, 1 John 2:28.
confession: Oh when the saints go marching in, when the saints go marching in, Oh lord I want to be in that number, when the saints go marching in. [Distributors and marketers are needed]. Pray with Special Breakthrough Prayers and spend quality time with God.

title: : MAINT AIN THE BALANCE
body: : MAINT AIN THE BALANCE “Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding” (KJV) Pro 4:7 Life is never a do-it-alone affair. You can't figure it out all alone. Surround yourself with people of like precious purpose, passion and pursuit. You need people you can share ideas, visions and dreams with. With such people, you can discuss real life issues peculiar to your visions and dreams. You can as well support one another as found applicable. “As one piece of iron sharpens another, so friends keep each other sharp.” (ERV) Pro 27:17. Another important way of maintaining balance is in having a clearly written visions and purposes of your life, Hab 2:2-3. When you write, write with specification. Write with time-frame. Write with clarity. With these, you’ll be able to keep yourself on track and be strategic.
prayer: Dear Father, I ask this day that You guide me through in all my endeavours. May I not miss my way in the journey of life. Order my steps and take the lead in all my life-pursuit in Jesus’ name, Amen. [Be a blessing! Be a lift! Reach out to people within your circle of influence with free copies of My Heart-to-Heart Talk this Christmas season.]
